title: Number as input, and check if it is an Adam number

content.problemStatement: Write a program to accept a number as input, and check if it is an Adam number.

solution.approach: Process inputs via standard stream input and apply required transformations.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not s: return
    n = int(s)
    sq = n * n
    rev_n = int(str(n)[::-1])
    rev_sq = rev_n * rev_n
    print("YES" if str(sq) == str(rev_sq)[::-1] else "NO")
if __name__ == '__main__': main()
